notes: These criteria are applied by the Godspeed Deal Intake Agent during Step 3 thesis screening. Update this file and system_prompt.md together whenever criteria change.

rating_logic.partial: Revenue slightly outside range but within reasonable proximity

rating_logic.unknown: EBITDA or Revenue not found — margin cannot be calculated

rating_logic.partial: Company has a clear and documented path to profitability
rating_logic.not_met: Company is not profitable and no path to profitability is evident

rating_logic.met: Document demonstrates a defensible competitive position in defined market
rating_logic.partial: Some evidence of market differentiation but not clearly defensible
rating_logic.not_met: No evidence of defensible market position

rating_logic.met: Majority of revenue is recurring or contracted
rating_logic.partial: Mix of recurring and transactional revenue
rating_logic.unknown: Revenue composition not described in document

rating_logic.partial: Primarily international with some U.S. presence
rating_logic.not_met: No U.S. or North American operations

overall_rating_logic.possible_fit: 2 to 3 criteria rated Met or Partial
